subject.title: feat(ui): show background tasks live in the web Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw accept a first-party Control UI Tasks page and read-scoped `task` gateway broadcast once the review blockers are fixed?
rationale: The implementation adds a new visible Control UI route and gateway event surface, and the linked issue already carries protected maintainer/product-direction labels.

options.title: Accept After Repairs
options.body: Sponsor this first-party task ledger after the ordering bugs are fixed and the branch is cleanly mergeable.

options.title: Defer To Broader Dashboard Work
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and fold task visibility/cancel into broader dashboard/status planning instead of landing this page now.

options.title: Keep CLI And Chat Only
options.body: Decline the web route for now and leave background-task inspection/cancel on `openclaw tasks` and chat `/tasks`.

recommendation.title: Accept After Repairs
recommendation.body: Sponsor this first-party task ledger after the ordering bugs are fixed and the branch is cleanly mergeable.

likelyOwner.reason: The protected label, linked issue, and recent current-main gateway task work make steipete the strongest available decision owner.
